tools.name: search_dramas
tools.description: Find drama titles, aliases, remakes, people or shows matching genre/year filters. Resolve ambiguity before using a slug.

tools.name: get_drama
tools.description: Get published drama facts and sources. Plot prose is withheld by default; use spoiler options only with user permission.

tools.name: get_cast
tools.description: Find cast, character and creator credits, optionally filtered. Follow pagination for complete results.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Get published actor or creator information and a paginated filmography. Preserve unavailable or conflicting facts.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List episode metadata and approved evidence availability. Spoiler options control plot-bearing fields.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get exact season and episode metadata, schedule and approved description within the spoiler ceiling.

tools.name: search_episode_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve reviewed paraphrased evidence for a question about one episode. Defaults to that episode as the spoiler ceiling. Matching is lexical; no matching evidence is not proof that an event did not happen. Never invent an answer or quote dialogue.

tools.name: get_drama_updates
tools.description: Get published catalogue changes by category and page. These are database updates, not a live news or streaming-availability feed.

tools.name: search_drama_mentions
tools.description: Search published drama titles and person names for the ChatGPT Desktop composer picker. Returns up to twelve identity references; no story content. Empty queries show recent entries.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_dramas" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find drama titles, aliases, remakes, people or shows matching genre/year filters. Resolve ambiguity before using a slug.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
